papers.title: DIRAC makes complex spatial multi-omic data simpler to analyze
papers.summary: DIRAC (‘domain invariant representation through adaptive calibration’) is a framework that helps researchers to analyze complex spatial multi-omic data through two connected tasks: integrating omics layers within a sample and transferring annotations from reference datasets to new ones. Thus, DIRAC makes it easier to build interpretable tissue maps across multi-omic assays, platforms and biological systems
papers.llm_title_zh: DIRAC使复杂的空间多组学数据更易于分析。
papers.llm_title_bilingual: DIRAC使复杂的空间多组学数据更易于分析。 / DIRAC makes complex spatial multi-omic data simpler to analyze
papers.llm_research_question_zh: DIRAC（“通过自适应校准实现域不变表示”）是一种框架，它通过两项相互关联的任务帮助研究人员分析复杂的空间多组学数据：一是整合样本中的各组学数据层；二是将参考数据集中的注释信息迁移至新的数据集中。
llm_highlights_zh: 因此，DIRAC使得在多种组学分析方法、不同技术平台以及不同的生物系统中构建可解释的组织结构图谱变得更加容易。

all_papers.title: DIRAC makes complex spatial multi-omic data simpler to analyze
all_papers.summary: DIRAC (‘domain invariant representation through adaptive calibration’) is a framework that helps researchers to analyze complex spatial multi-omic data through two connected tasks: integrating omics layers within a sample and transferring annotations from reference datasets to new ones. Thus, DIRAC makes it easier to build interpretable tissue maps across multi-omic assays, platforms and biological systems
